ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; extreme bimodal contrast with sharp transitions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white sector on the lateral left lobe interspersed with black linear tracks; dense, interconnected white lattice/mottling across the lateral right lobe; solid black pigmentation dominated the central peduncle and medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 80 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 18% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude (10-20 pixel) irregular jaggedness on the distal left trailing edge; lower-frequency, lower-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations on the right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex upward sweep; left lobe exhibits a truncated, irregular curve due to edge tissue loss; right lobe follows a standard broad convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) scattered across the lower central black pigmentation and within the right lobe lattice.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional white-on-black linear streaks (rake marks) concentrated on the right lobe; multiple parallel diagonal streaks crossing the left lobe's white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular trauma/tissue loss along the trailing margin of the left lobe, resulting in a jagged, sawtooth-like boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe pigmentation is characterized by an exceptionally dense, textured scarring pattern that creates a 'marbled' high-contrast visual effect.
